root.name: ドクター・レディーズ・ラボラトリーズ

relations.text: 米国外の禁煙補助(NRT)ブランドをHaleonから取得
relations.text_en: Acquired the ex-US nicotine replacement therapy brands from Haleon

source.label: Dr. Reddy's 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: the portfolio outside of the United States of consumer brands in the Nicotine Replacement Therapy acquired from Haleon UK Enterprises Limited (the "NRT Business").

relations.text: Mayne Pharmaから製品関連の無形資産を取得(減損を計上)
relations.text_en: Acquired product-related intangible assets from Mayne Pharma (later impaired)

source.label: Dr. Reddy's 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: Consequent to adverse market conditions affecting certain product related intangible assets acquired from Mayne Pharma Group Limited ("Mayne"), the Company recognized an impairment loss

relations.text: インドで栄養補助食品を製造・販売する契約(2024年4月)
relations.text_en: Agreement to make and sell nutraceuticals in India (Apr 2024)

source.label: Dr. Reddy's 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: On April 25, 2024, the parent company entered into a definitive agreement with Nestlé India Limited ("Nestlé India"), for manufacturing, developing, promoting, marketing, selling, distributing, and commercializing nutraceutical products and supplements in India

relations.text: デノスマブのバイオシミラーを米欧で販売する提携(2024年)
relations.text_en: 2024 partnership to sell a denosumab biosimilar in the US and Europe

source.label: Dr. Reddy's 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: such as our 2024 partnership with Alvotech for the commercialization of a biosimilar candidate to Prolia® and Xgeva® (denosumab) in the United States and Europe, and our 2025 partnership with Shanghai Henlius Biotech, Inc. for the commercialization of the biosimilar product, 'daratumumab biosimilar HLX15' in the United States and Europe.

relations.text: ダラツムマブのバイオシミラーを米欧で販売する提携(2025年)
relations.text_en: 2025 partnership to sell a daratumumab biosimilar in the US and Europe

source.label: Dr. Reddy's 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: such as our 2024 partnership with Alvotech for the commercialization of a biosimilar candidate to Prolia® and Xgeva® (denosumab) in the United States and Europe, and our 2025 partnership with Shanghai Henlius Biotech, Inc. for the commercialization of the biosimilar product, 'daratumumab biosimilar HLX15' in the United States and Europe.
